about: Which vision question answers each look fault Tom named in his chapter 1 review (clipgate2). Key: fault, then the move (or * for any move not listed); value: the question ids, any one answered no counts. Written from what each fault means, not from the clips' own notes. Used by tools/clip-gate/replay_vision.py.

not_gated.length: A bake setting (clip.speed) and a matter of taste: approved and rejected clips overlap at 1.4 to 2.1 s, so no honest measure separates them. Fixed in clipch1fix (moves at speed 1.0 except give).
